name: KPI - Median Nightly Price
description: Median source nightly price across non-outlier listings. One row per listing; robust to extreme prices. Fixed card, not filtered by the dashboard.

stages.native:
SELECT
    MAX(median_price) AS median_price
FROM (
    SELECT
        PERCENTILE_CONT(price, 0.5) OVER () AS median_price
    FROM analytics.dim_listings AS dim_listings
WHERE NOT is_price_outlier
);
